z-m-27-01.title: Zingaphi iindlela zokwabela iilekese ezi-6?
z-m-27-01.topic: Inani leendlela zokwabela iilekese: ukuba iilekese ziyahlulwa na nokuba izandla ezingenanto ziyavunyelwa na
z-m-27-01.goal: Qonda ukuba isivakalisi esithi 'inani leendlela zokwabela' sodwa asigqibi impendulo enye, uze ubhale kwakhona ingxaki ngokuthetha wena iimeko ezifunekayo ukugqiba impendulo (ukuba iilekese ziyahlulwa na, ukuba izandla ezingenanto ziyavunyelwa na).
z-m-27-01.material: Sifuna ukwabela zonke iilekese ezi-6 kubantu abathathu, 갑, 을, kunye ne-병. 갑, 을, kunye ne-병 banamagama amisiweyo, ngoko ngabantu abahlukeneyo. Iindlela zokwabela iilekese zibalwa ngesiphumo 'ngubani ofumene ntoni.' Ukuba isiphumo sifanayo, yindlela efanayo, kwaye ulandelelwano lokunika iilekese alubalwa. Ingxaki sisivakalisi esinye kuphela. "Zingaphi iindlela zokwabela iilekese ezi-6 kubantu abathathu?"
z-m-27-01.thinking.0: Ukugweba ukuba ulwazi lwanele na phambi kokufumana impendulo
z-m-27-01.thinking.1: Ukuqikelela indlela inani leemeko elitshintsha ngayo xa iimeko zitshintsha
z-m-27-01.thinking.2: Ukuhlola ngokwakha iimeko ezimiselwe iimeko zazo
z-m-27-01.thinking.3: Ukubhala kwakhona ingxaki engacacanga ukuze ibe nempendulo enye
z-m-27-01.prereq.0: Ukubhala iimeko njengezibini ezilandelelanayo nokuzidwelisa ngaphandle kokulahlekelwa
z-m-27-01.prereq.1: Umthetho wemveliso nomthetho wesixa (inqanaba lecandelo lokuqala 'lokubala iimeko' kwiMathematika Eqhelekileyo yesikolo samabanga aphezulu)
z-m-27-01.prereq.2: I-H2 kumsebenzi wenqanaba lesikolo yilebhile yobunzima kuphela kwisicwangciso sale mveliso, hayi umsebenzi webanga lesikolo. Cinga ukuba iingcinga ezisisiseko zecandelo 'lokubala iimeko' sele zifundiwe.
z-m-27-01.s.s1.prompt: Ukuze esi sivakalisi sinye sodwa sibe nempendulo enye, kufuneka siyazi ntoni ngakumbi ngokuqinisekileyo? Khetha zonke ezisebenzayo.
z-m-27-01.s.s1.hint.0: Hlukanisa, njengokuzoba umgca, iimeko sele zibhaliwe kumbhalo wengxaki neemeko ezingabhalwanga.
z-m-27-01.s.s1.hint.1: Lungisa inani elinye le-(갑, 을, 병) ukuze isiphumo sihlale sinjalo, ucinge ukuba yeyiphi imeko, ukuba itshintshiwe, eya kwenza esi siphumo sahluke okanye singenzeki.
z-m-27-01.s.s1.o.a: Ubudala babantu abathathu 갑, 을, kunye ne-병
z-m-27-01.s.s1.r.a: Ubudala abunanto yakwenza nokuba zingaphi iindlela zokwahlula. Cinga ukuba ngowuphi ulwazi otshintsha indlela yokubala.
z-m-27-01.s.s1.o.b: Ukuba iilekese ezi-6 ziyahlulwa enye kwenye na
z-m-27-01.s.s1.r.b: Uqaphele ukuba ngokuxhomekeke ekubeni iilekese ziyahlulwa na, nokuba isabelo samanani esifanayo singabalwa njengeendlela ezahlukeneyo.
z-m-27-01.s.s1.o.c: Ukuba iilekese zinikwa enye ngexesha ngokuyiselana okanye zonke kanye
z-m-27-01.s.s1.r.c: Le ngxaki imiselwe ukubala isiphumo kuphela hayi ulandelelwano lokunika. Sele yimeko emisiweyo.
z-m-27-01.s.s1.o.d: Ukuba kulungile ukuba omnye wabantu abathathu angafumani lekese kwaphela
z-m-27-01.s.s1.r.d: Uqaphele ukuba ukuba iimeko apho umntu ofumana i-0 ziqukiwe okanye hayi kutshintsha uluhlu lweemeko ezinokwenzeka ngokwalo.
z-m-27-01.s.s1.o.e: Ukuba 갑, 을, kunye ne-병 ngabantu abahlukeneyo
z-m-27-01.s.s1.r.e: Sele kubhaliwe ukuba banamagama amisiweyo. Hlukanisa ulwazi olunikiweyo nolwazi olulahlekileyo.
z-m-27-01.s.s1.explain: Zikho amaqhekeza amabini olwazi olulahlekileyo. Ngokuxhomekeke ekubeni iilekese ziyahlulwa na, nokuba amanani ayafana, njenge-(갑 4, 을 1, 병 1), iba yindlela eyahlukileyo ukuba iilekese ezifunyenweyo ziyahluka. Kwakhona, iimeko ezinokwenzeka zitshintsha ngokuxhomekeke ekubeni isandla esingenanto siyavunyelwa na. Ukuba abantu bayahlulwa nokuba ulandelelwano lokunika alubalwa sele zinikiwe.
z-m-27-01.s.s2.prompt: Masilungise imeko apho zonke iilekese ezi-6 zohlobo olufanayo kwaye bonke abantu abathathu bafumana i-1 ubuncinane nganye. Faka iindlela ezi-6 ezahlukeneyo. (inani elifunyenwe ngu-갑 yi-a, inani elifunyenwe ngu-을 yi-b, inani elifunyenwe ngu-병 yi-c)
z-m-27-01.s.s2.hint.0: Kuqala gqiba inani elifunyenwe ngumntu omnye, ujonge ukuba isixa samanani afunyenwe ngabanye abantu ababini kufuneka sibe yintoni.
z-m-27-01.s.s2.hint.1: Ngaba (4,1,1) kunye ne-(1,4,1) yindlela efanayo? Hlola ngokuchasene nomgangatho wombhalo wengxaki othi 'ukuba isiphumo sifanayo, yindlela efanayo.'
z-m-27-01.s.s2.ok.c1: Bonke abantu abathathu banee-1 okanye ngaphezulu.
z-m-27-01.s.s2.fail.c1: Bonke abantu abathathu kufuneka bafumane i-1 ubuncinane nganye.
z-m-27-01.s.s2.ok.c2: Iilekese azinakwahlulwa, ngoko amanani ngamanani apheleleyo.
z-m-27-01.s.s2.fail.c2: Inani leelekese kufuneka libe linani eliphelele.
z-m-27-01.s.s2.fail.c3: Isixa samanani afunyenwe ngabantu abathathu kufuneka sibe yi-6.
z-m-27-01.s.s2.explain: Phantsi kwale meko zikho iindlela ezili-10 zonke. (1,1,4), (1,4,1), kunye ne-(4,1,1) zibalwa njengeendlela ezahlukeneyo kuba umntu ofumana iilekese ezi-4 uyahluka. Kungenxa yokuba abantu abathathu bayahlulwa. Nokuba iqela elifanayo lamanani (1,2,3) lahlulwa libe ziindlela ezi-6 ngokuxhomekeke ekubeni ngubani ofumana zingaphi.
z-m-27-01.s.s3.prompt: Ngeli xesha cinga ukuba iilekese ezi-6 zonke zezinye iincasa kwaye kulungile ukuba umntu angafumani nto. Xa kuthelekiswa nokwahlula iilekese zohlobo olufanayo ngezandla ezingenanto ezivunyelweyo (iindlela ezingama-28), kwenzeka ntoni kwinani leendlela?
z-m-27-01.s.s3.hint.0: Khetha isabelo esinye sosuku olufanayo, (4,1,1), usebenze ngokuthe ngqo ukuba eso sabelo sahlulwa sibe ziindlela ezingaphi xa iilekese ziyahlulwa.
z-m-27-01.s.s3.hint.1: Cinga ngokugqiba, ilekese ngelekese, 'ngubani wabantu abathathu ofumana yona,' ubale ukuba olo khetho luphindwa kangaphi.
z-m-27-01.s.s3.o.a: Liyancipha. Kuba iilekese kufuneka ziyahlulwe, imeko iqine ngakumbi.
z-m-27-01.s.s3.r.a: Ukwahlula iilekese akwenzi sabelo senzeka sinyamalale. Jonga ukuba isabelo samanani esifanayo sahlulwa sibe ziindlela ezingaphi.
z-m-27-01.s.s3.o.b: Liyafana, iindlela ezingama-28. Kuba inani leelekese nelabantu lihleli linjalo.
z-m-27-01.s.s3.r.b: Nokuba amanani eelekese nawabantu ayafana, kwisabelo esifanayo (4,1,1) yindlela eyahlukileyo ukuba ngubani ofumana ziphi iilekese yahlukile.
z-m-27-01.s.s3.o.c: Liyanda. Kuba isabelo esinye sahlulwa sibe ziindlela ezininzi.
z-m-27-01.s.s3.r.c: Ukhombe ukuba nje ukuba iilekese ziyahlulwa, isabelo esinye siqhekeka sibe ziindlela ezininzi.
z-m-27-01.s.s3.r.d: Unokuthelekisa ubukhulu ngaphandle kokubala konke, ngokujonga isabelo esinye kuphela nokuba sahlulwa sibe ziindlela ezingaphi.
z-m-27-01.s.s3.explain: Ukuba iilekese zonke ziyahlukile, ilekese nganye ikhetha omnye wabantu abathathu, ngoko li-3 kumandla ase-6, oko kukuthi iindlela ezingama-729. Oko kukhulu kakhulu kuneendlela ezingama-28 zohlobo olufanayo. Kungenxa yokuba nganye yezingama-28 ihlulwa ibe ziindlela ezininzi. Umzekelo, i-(4,1,1) yodwa ihlulwa ibe ngamaninzi ngokuxhomekeke ekubeni ngowuphi iilekese ezi-4 ezifunyenwe ngu-갑.
z-m-27-01.s.s4.prompt: Phinda ubhale isivakalisi sokuqala ubhale ingxaki ngeetoliko ezimbini ezahlukeneyo ukuze nganye ibe nempendulo enye. Akufuneki ufumane iimpendulo (zingaphi iindlela), kodwa zibhale ukuze kucace ukuba ziyiphi iimeko ozongeze.
z-m-27-01.s.s4.hint.0: Lungisa amaqhekeza amabini olwazi olulahlekileyo owakhetha kuqala, elinye ngexesha, uwafake kwisivakalisi.
z-m-27-01.s.s4.hint.1: Iitoliko ezimbini kufuneka zahluke kwimeko enye ubuncinane. Gqiba ukuba yeyiphi imeko uza kuyitshintsha uyibhale.
z-m-27-01.s.s4.selfAssess.0: Ungathi kumgca omnye ukuba yeyiphi imeko eyahlukileyo phakathi kweetoliko ezimbini ozibhalileyo?
z-m-27-01.s.s4.selfAssess.1: Xa ufunda utoliko ngalunye, ungazi ukuba iilekese ziyafana okanye ziyahlulwa?
z-m-27-01.s.s4.selfAssess.2: Kutoliko ngalunye, ungazi ukuba kulungile ukuba umntu angafumani lekese?
z-m-27-01.s.s4.model.0: Utoliko 1) Zonke iilekese ezi-6 zohlobo olufanayo, kwaye kulungile ukuba umntu afumane i-0. Utoliko 2) Zonke iilekese ezi-6 zezinye iincasa, kwaye kulungile ukuba umntu angafumani nto.
z-m-27-01.s.s4.model.1: Ingabhalwa njengenani leendlela zokwahlula iilekese ezi-6 ezifanayo ukuze bonke abantu abathathu bafumane i-1 ubuncinane nganye, okanye njengenani leendlela zokwahlula iilekese ezi-6 ezihlulwayo ukuze akho namnye ushiyiweyo.
z-m-27-01.s.s4.modelNote.1: Le mpendulo ikhethe indibaniselwano yesithathu yeemeko (ukuhlulwa + wonke umntu ufumana i-1 okanye ngaphezulu). Nokuba indibaniselwano iyahluka, isebenza ukuba iimeko ziyacaca.
